roles.role: Founding Operator (#4), then Head of Product
roles.outcome: Joined as employee #4 to build operations and grew the company from 4 to 40 people. Did ISO 27001 and 9001 solo as DPO, which unlocked our first FTSE 100 contracts. Then led product: the AI STEM tutor went from first commit to the App Store in under a month, and the DfE picked it for its AI Tutoring Tools Pioneers Programme, 2nd of eight with a £300k grant.
roles.photoAlt: The Zero Gravity team in the office, gathered round a sofa under the company sign

paras: Elliot is the ultimate startup operator — a genuine Swiss Army knife who has made an impact across customer success, operations and product at Zero Gravity.

He doesn't just understand what AI makes possible; he builds with it, experiments rapidly and ships. He now contributes as many PRs as some of our senior engineers, while bringing the customer insight and commercial judgement you would expect from a strong product leader.
If I were starting another business tomorrow, Elliot would be one of the first people I'd try to hire.
quote.name: Joe Seddon

roles.outcome: Led product and operations for Farewill's probate service, working between customers, legal specialists and the case team. Shipped workflow automation, case tracking and integrations with HMCTS, HMRC and banking that cut agent errors 69% and case handling from two weeks to four days, plus a vulnerable-user framework adopted company-wide.

Co-founded a volunteer-run charity during COVID. Built a four-sided marketplace in 10 days across 146 hospitals and 223 restaurants: day 1 was a WhatsApp group, day 10 was production. £1.8m raised, 303,000 meals delivered in 100 days.
Built the CX and crisis operations behind 400% YoY growth, scaling the team from 10 to 160 across 30+ markets, with NPS held above 90 through the US launch.
